title: Big Screen Classics: City Slickers (1991) at Moxie Cinema
seo_title: City Slickers (1991) – Big Screen Classics, Springfield MO
description: This is a screening of City Slickers (1991), a PG-13 comedy western running 115 minutes, in the Big Screen Classics series sponsored by Hotel Vandivort. Billy Crystal stars as a disillusioned New Yorker who joins his friends on a two-week cattle drive from New Mexico to Colorado, led by a grizzled trail boss. It takes place Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Moxie Cinema, 305 S Campbell Ave #101, Springfield, MO.
